component.name: RGBMatrixFX
component.summary: Chroma-style lighting effects for RGB keyboards and mice

description.p: RGBMatrixFX renders animated lighting effects onto Razer keyboards and mice through the OpenRazer driver. A small background engine keeps your lighting running; the window lets you pick and tune effects live, build presets and manage per-zone lighting.

ul.li: 14 effects modelled on Razer Chroma effects, each fully tunable
One scene across keyboard and mouse, plus reactive ripples on key presses
Highlight key groups, Gamer Controls and per-zone colours
Follows your desktop's light or dark theme and accent colour
Lists your motherboard, RAM and fan lighting found by OpenRGB

description.p: RGBMatrixFX needs the OpenRazer driver and daemon. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Razer Inc. Razer is a trademark of Razer Inc.

screenshot.caption: Effects gallery with the live preview

description.p: Renamed from RazorFX to RGBMatrixFX (settings are copied over). The Devices box lists motherboard, RAM and fan lighting found by OpenRGB; the installer sets OpenRGB up. Help has an optional Support link.

Renamed to RazorFX (Nitrofire Computing). The window uses PySide6, follows the desktop theme, and has a menu bar plus an expanded About dialog. Gamer Controls and Highlight keys use key chips; adding arbitrary keys is a Pro preview (coming soon, not for sale). Packages for Debian, Fedora, Arch and AppImage. Per-device key maps, layout packs and an example preset.
